overview: 5G Radio Cell Congestion Forecasting addresses teams rely on lagging aggregates when forecasts or decisions depend on changing operational conditions in telecommunications operations. The first proof of value uses RAN counters, traffic forecasts and carrier configurations. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is peak cell congestion minutes, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: RAN counters, traffic forecasts and carrier configurations; define peak cell congestion minutes and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Network Operations Director / Telco Product VP.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including backtest across seasonal and peak periods with a holdout cohort.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
